facts.text: The hotel is in Ginza, just off Chuo Street.
facts.excerpt: The hotel is situated just off Chuo Street

facts.text: The hotel's understated luxury was crafted by Ian Schrager and Kengo Kuma.
facts.excerpt: understated luxury carefully crafted by Ian Schrager and Kengo Kuma

facts.text: The suites have interiors of rich, warm walnut wood with white and marble furnishings.
facts.excerpt: Boasting interiors adorned in rich, warm walnut wood complemented by furnishings in white and marble

facts.text: Connected rooms are available via exterior connecting doors to create a two-bedroom suite.
facts.excerpt: Connected rooms are available via exterior connecting doors to create a lavish two-bedroom suite.

facts.text: The hotel has a Penthouse with spacious living and dining areas and a pantry.
facts.excerpt: Penthouse, featuring stylishly spacious living and dining areas and pantry

facts.text: Punch Room is the first bar in Japan to offer an authentic punch bowl ritual, inspired by 19th-century London private clubs.
facts.excerpt: The first bar in Japan to offer an authentic punch bowl ritual, inspired by 19th-century London private clubs

facts.text: Punch Room Tokyo is ranked No. 23 on Asia's 50 Best Bars 2026.
facts.excerpt: Punch Room Tokyo is proud to be ranked No. 23 on Asia

facts.text: Sophie at EDITION is an Italian restaurant on the 14th floor.
facts.excerpt: Located on the 14th floor of The Tokyo EDITION, Ginza, Sophie at EDITION is an authentic Italian restaurant

facts.text: Sophie at EDITION has a handmade pasta program at the heart of its menu.
facts.excerpt: with its signature handmade pasta program at the heart of the offering

facts.text: The roof-top bar offers natural wines, cocktails and eaux de vie from local wineries and distilleries, surrounded by lush greenery.
facts.excerpt: natural wines, cocktails, and eaux de vie from local wineries and distilleries, surrounded by lush greenery

facts.text: The Roof is a seasonal rooftop destination.

facts.excerpt: The gold-colored bar, surrounded by ivory fabric armchairs and a sweeping statement sofa

facts.text: The hotel has a 24-hour gym powered by Technogym.
A Black Tea scent created with Le Labo is used in public spaces and bathroom amenities.
facts.excerpt: exclusive Black Tea scent enjoyed in public space and bathroom amenities, created in collaboration with Le Labo

facts.text: Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
A private car to and from Haneda Airport can be arranged by the hotel's guest service before arrival or departure.
